items.question: Which Maid Cafe Simulator does this wiki cover?
items.answer: The Steam game by Accelix and SCON, App ID 3232690. This is an independent guide and covers no Roblox mechanics or redemption codes.

items.question: Can you transfer a demo save into the full game?
items.answer: Demo transfer is currently affected by a confirmed issue. On October 13, the developer advised starting a new game while a fix is prepared. The launch Demo-slot instruction is historical; the older September demo reset is a separate event.

items.question: What are the full-game level caps?
items.answer: The developer’s launch announcement gives a cafe level cap of 40 and a maid level cap of 15. Demo caps are different.

items.question: How many Steam achievements are listed?
items.answer: 23: twenty with public objectives and three with hidden descriptions. This wiki lists the hidden names without inventing their unlock conditions.

items.question: Do you need DLC to finish the base game?
items.answer: The developer says all DLC is optional and the complete base game can be played without it. Outfit DLC is character-specific; Maidroid DLC adds a helper that can be assigned jobs.

items.question: Does this wiki have every recipe and every ending?
items.answer: Complete recipe quantities, all chapter steps and branching ending triggers have not been verified. They are held back rather than presented as complete guides.
